prompt.text:
STYLE A "Refined ink": Premium hand-painted character portrait for a narrative game. Mature, realistic adult proportions and believable faces with subtle, restrained acting. Confident dark contour lines that vary from hairline-thin to bold, used sparingly where form turns, never a uniform cartoon outline. Painterly gouache rendering with soft-to-hard edge control: crisp edges on the face, crown and hands, lost edges where the figure melts into shadow. One motivated key light, deep shadow covering half the figure, a thin precise rim light. Restrained palette: ink-navy and charcoal darks, one warm or cyan accent, small gold details. Generous negative space; the figure is composed like an editorial poster, not centered like a snapshot. Fine material detail on metal, cloth and skin, but calm overall.
SUBJECT: Edmund, 26, assassinated royal naval prince returned as undead. Lean, angular, tired handsome face, swept dark hair, strong brows. His anatomical LEFT half of the face (viewer right) is bare skull with a turquoise flame in the eye socket; the other half is human. A narrow gold crown visibly snapped at the front. Worn ivory-white plate armour with aged gold trim, a torn purple cape, the hilt of a soulfire sword at his shoulder. Expression: controlled resolve.
ACCENT LIGHT: cyan-green soulfire.
FORMAT: dialogue half-body portrait, vertical 4:5 (1024x1280), cropped at the waist, three-quarter view toward the viewer, plain dark background suited to sitting beside a dialogue box. NEGATIVE: absolutely no text, letters, logos or watermarks; no chibi, no cute or childlike faces, no low-poly, no 3D render look, no plastic shine; no names of existing games, studios or artists.

Form built with fine engraved hatching and cross-hatching in deep ink-navy, large flat shapes of shadow, a very limited palette: aged paper ivory, ink navy, burnished gold, plus ONE glowing accent (cyan-green soulfire for the undead, warm sun-gold for the living). Precise, elegant, austere; strong silhouette; subtle paper grain. No soft airbrush, no cartoon shapes.
SUBJECT: Captain Bernard, undead captain of the guard: broad, battered steel-grey plate, enclosed naval great-helm with a narrow visor slit glowing cyan-green, scratched crown insignia, purple cloak, the top edge of a dented shield. Posture: steady, loyal, about to disagree politely.
ACCENT LIGHT: cyan-green soulfire.
FORMAT: dialogue half-body portrait, vertical 4:5 (1024x1280), cropped at the waist, three-quarter view toward the viewer, plain dark background suited to sitting beside a dialogue box. NEGATIVE: absolutely no text, letters, logos or watermarks; no chibi, no cute or childlike faces, no low-poly, no 3D render look, no plastic shine; no names of existing games, studios or artists.
REFERENCE IMAGES: attached is this character's current approved design sheet. Keep the identity, costume, colours and props exactly; change ONLY the rendering style as described.

identity_and_costume.evidence: 封闭海军大盔、青绿狭目缝、旧板甲、皇冠胸徽、紫披风、圆扣及金边皇冠盾保留。
notes: 保留低饱和紫披风和纸色甲面高光；C 的有限配色会使钢灰甲更接近旧纸色。
自由手改为轻微摊掌的劝阻姿态；持剑手与剑未进入本版半身画面。

style.evidence: 精细金属排线与交叉刻线、墨蓝大暗块、象牙纸色和金色点缀，青绿发光目缝；与 A/B 明确区分。

no_text.evidence: 已查看实际生成图，未见文字、字母、签名或水印。

no_extra_hands_or_feet.evidence: 扶盾手与可见自由手/手臂无额外肢体；脚不在画面内。
